numbering: Episodes numbered continuously 1-50 (R1 is 1-25, R2 is 26-50); the Re;surrection film has no episode number.

arcs.name: Birth of Zero
arcs.summary: Exiled prince Lelouch gains the power of Geass and begins a masked rebellion against the Britannian Empire.
events: Lelouch receives Geass from the witch C.C. in Shinjuku.
He kills his half-brother Clovis and becomes Zero.
Suzaku becomes the pilot of the Lancelot.

arcs.name: The Black Knights
arcs.summary: Zero builds a resistance army and takes on Cornelia's forces in open battle.
events: Zero founds the Order of the Black Knights.
The Battle of Narita causes a landslide that kills Shirley's father.

arcs.name: Geass vs. Geass
arcs.summary: Other Geass users and personal ties start to complicate Lelouch's double life.
events: Lelouch uses Geass to erase Shirley's memories of him.
The mind-reader Mao targets C.C. and Nunnally.
Euphemia chooses Suzaku as her knight.

arcs.name: Kamine Island and Kyushu
arcs.summary: Zero and Suzaku's conflict escalates while the origins of Geass come into view.
events: Lelouch is forced to Geass Suzaku to live.
Zero, Suzaku and Euphemia are stranded on Kamine Island and stumble on ancient Geass ruins.
Zero and Suzaku team up to repel a Chinese Federation-backed invasion of Kyushu.

arcs.name: Black Rebellion
arcs.summary: A peace proposal at the Ashford school festival turns into a bloodbath that ignites full-scale rebellion.
events: Lelouch's Geass accidentally orders Euphemia to kill the Japanese.
Zero shoots Euphemia and launches the Black Rebellion in Tokyo.
Suzaku unmasks Zero and the two face off at gunpoint.

arcs.name: Zero's Return
arcs.summary: A year later, Lelouch lives with rewritten memories until C.C. restores them.
events: Lelouch's memories return and Zero reappears.
Rolo, a Geass-wielding 'brother', is planted to watch him.
Lelouch wins Rolo over and saves Black Knights from execution.

arcs.name: The Chinese Federation
arcs.summary: Zero relocates the Black Knights to China while juggling school life and imperial enemies.
events: The Knights of the Round arrive in Area 11.
Zero disrupts the Tianzi's arranged marriage and sparks a Chinese revolution.
The United States of Japan is effectively set up abroad.

arcs.name: The Geass Directorate
arcs.summary: Lelouch strikes at the source of Geass after a personal tragedy.
events: Shirley regains her memories and is killed by Rolo.
Lelouch wipes out the Geass Directorate.
Lelouch confronts his father in the C's World.

arcs.name: Tokyo II and Betrayal
arcs.summary: The United Federation of Nations takes shape and war returns to Tokyo.
events: Suzaku launches a FLEIJA bomb over Tokyo, devastating the city.
Nunnally is believed dead.
Schneizel turns the Black Knights against Zero.

arcs.name: Zero Requiem
arcs.summary: Lelouch seizes the throne and stakes everything on one final plan.
events: Lelouch defeats his father and mother in the Sword of Akasha.
Lelouch becomes Emperor of Britannia.
In the Zero Requiem, Suzaku as Zero kills Lelouch to end the cycle of hatred.

arcs.name: Lelouch of the Re;surrection
arcs.summary: A sequel film set after the compilation-film version of the story, in which Lelouch is brought back.
events: C.C. revives Lelouch in the desert kingdom of Zilkhstan.
Lelouch helps rescue Nunnally and Suzaku.
Lelouch leaves with C.C., calling himself L.L.

filler.note: Anime original, so there's no filler.
